hook.say: You know these countries. But do you know their capitals? Five questions, and they keep getting harder!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: What is the capital of India?
questions.fact: New Delhi was inaugurated as the capital in 1931.
questions.sayAnswer: New Delhi! It was inaugurated as the capital in 1931.

questions.q: What is the capital of Vietnam?
questions.fact: Ho Chi Minh City is bigger, but Hanoi in the north is the capital.
questions.sayAnswer: Hanoi! Ho Chi Minh City is bigger, but Hanoi in the north is the capital.

questions.q: What is the capital of Pakistan?
questions.fact: Islamabad was built in the 1960s to replace Karachi as the capital.
questions.sayAnswer: Islamabad! It was built in the 1960s to replace Karachi as the capital.

questions.q: What is the capital of Nigeria?
questions.fact: Abuja, a planned city, took over from Lagos in 1991.
questions.sayAnswer: Ah-boo-ja! This planned city took over from Lagos in 1991.

questions.q: What is the capital of Kazakhstan?
questions.fact: Astana was renamed Nur-Sultan in 2019, then changed back in 2022.
questions.sayAnswer: Astana! It was renamed Noor Sultan in 2019, then changed back to Astana in 2022.
